column1: # fleet-pause registry: how each workflow in this repository answers the fleet
# pause switch, the Actions variable AGENTS_PAUSED (#1525, #2249).
# Data, not code. This file is the ONE place the decision is recorded:
#     when a model-calling workflow has no row, or when a row does not match the
#   - the inventory table in AGENTS.md ("Pausing the agent fleet") is generated
#     from it (`--markdown`), and tests/test_fleet_pause_coverage.bats fails when
# A workflow is MODEL-CALLING when, outside comments, a job
#   2. names an AI CLI or action (@anthropic-ai/claude-code, @google/gemini-cli,
#      anthropics/claude-code-action, gh copilot, gh models), or
#   3. calls a reusable workflow with `secrets: inherit` (every secret, the
#      model credentials included, reaches that reusable).
# The engine scripts cannot reach a model without one of those credentials, and
# only a workflow can hand one over, so rule 1 covers them.

column4: note

column1: #   mode      job-gate         the jobs in `detail` (comma-separated) carry
#                              of their `if:`, and a `fleet-paused` job logs why
#             job-gate-silent  the same job condition, with no notice job
#                              carry the condition, the rest of the job still
#                              runs, and one step logs why
#             caller           thin caller of the reusable in `detail`, a file
#                              in this repository that is itself gated
#             upstream         NOT PAUSED: the model call is in the reusable in
#             exempt           deliberately not paused; `note` says why
#   note      one sentence; required for upstream and exempt; `-` when unused
# To add a model-calling workflow: gate its model-calling job (copy the `if:` and
# the `fleet-paused` job from any job-gate workflow) and add a row, or add an
# exempt row with the reason. Then regenerate the AGENTS.md table.
# ── Agents and model-calling workflows, gated here ───────────────────────────
